justification: Panel A depicts dense rows of hieroglyphic script with two seated/kneeling human figures in low relief, while Panel B depicts a framed composition with a spiral rosette medallion, flanking animals (ibex-like creatures and deer), and decorative border bands of waves and dots. There is no shared iconographic content: no script versus a geometric spiral motif, and no correspondence in the figures (human scribal/ritual figures vs. quadruped animals) or their arrangement on the surface.
